HF18 closes the current Universal API Bridge and tester-feedback push. It adds universal D3D11 native-Present startup stabilization, deterministic fail-open API ownership/capability routing, stronger source-backed face/color/edge/microtexture reconstruction, independent Motion Protection and Ghosting Guard strength, Control Deck help, updater/install/uninstall fixes, and a D3D11 WARP rendered-quality matrix covering all 42 exposed floating image controls.

The exact final package passed x86/x64 production and legacy builds, HLSL compilation, WARP rendered visual-quality gates, installer/rollback/manual-add regressions, ZIP integrity/hash verification and Microsoft Defender scans with 0 detections.

Vulkan/OpenGL support remains conservative lifecycle/presentation compatibility observation rather than a claim of full ELYSIUM/neural parity. AMD shares the vendor-neutral ELYSIUM image path, but this CI result is not an AMD hardware test. Real-game quality, motion and performance acceptance remains title/GPU/driver specific.

The public repository contains release information, documentation and support material. The full engineering source/workspace remains private.
